# Fortune Intern Network

> Fortune Intern Network connects students and internship seekers in Ghana with internship opportunities, and helps them discover, apply for and track internships in one place.

## Main pages

- [Home and open internships](https://fortuneintern.com/): browse current internship opportunities as a guest, then sign in to apply
- [About us](https://fortuneintern.com/about): who we are
- [Contact](https://fortuneintern.com/contact): how to reach the team
- [Privacy policy](https://fortuneintern.com/privacy-policy): how personal data and cookies are handled
- [Terms and conditions](https://fortuneintern.com/terms): terms of use and refund rules

## Notes

- Applying, tracking applications and student documents need a signed-in student account.
- Customer service email: fortuneintern.gh@gmail.com
